summary.text: In her December 2023 DOE testimony, Fu described AI as offering major national opportunities while also recognizing significant risks to safety, democracy, the economy, and rights. She called for government, private-sector, and international partnerships to ensure Americans benefit from AI adoption and are protected from potential harms. In September 2024, she advocated DOE’s FASST initiative to develop frontier-scale AI for science, energy, and national security, alongside governance, safety, and workforce development.
